decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - 11.1	It considered that the proposed retention of a single storey side / rear extension, two storey side extension and first floor rear extension to the dwellinghouse is in keeping with the appearance and character of the dwellinghouse and will not have any detrimental effects on the amenity of the adjoining neighbours. The development is in accordance with Policy ENV - B.1.1 (New Development), Policy H.4.1 - Housing Standards and Guidelines and Policy H.6.4 - Extensions and Alterations of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and is compliant with the provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Retention of single storey side/rear extensions, two storey side and first floor rear extensions to dwellinghouse.
